                                if first_degree >= k_sub - 1 and last_degree >= k_sub - 1:
                                    max_k_sub = k_sub
                                    break
                        else:
                            max_k_sub = k_sub
                            break
                return max_k_sub

            # Now use compute_degree to check the conditions for k
            if k == 0:
                max_k = 0
                break
            if k > 0:
                if not is_pal:
                    continue
                if k - 1 > 0:
                    first_part = s[:k-1]
                    last_part = s[-k+1:] if k-1 > 0 else ""
                    first_degree = compute_degree(first_part)
                    last_degree = compute_degree(last_part)
                    if first_degree >= k - 1 and last_degree >= k - 1:
                        max_k = k
                        break
                else:
                    max_k = k
                    break
        degree[l] = max_k
        total += max_k

    print(total)

    main()
